item.title: Limited agricultural gains but high flood risk from global wetland reclamation
item.content:encoded:
Nature Sustainability, Published online: 09 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01965-x

As food demand increases, global wetlands are being reclaimed as croplands; however, these reclaimed croplands are not only less productive, but also face substantially higher flood exposure. This dual vulnerability highlights the urgency of balancing food security with wetland conservation.
